analyst.summary: Gallantt Ispat's steel business is going through a genuine down-cycle: revenue has stopped growing, profit fell nearly 29% in the most recent quarter, and operating margins have compressed meaningfully - classic signs of a commodity-cycle squeeze rather than a one-off accounting item. The company is also taking on more debt to fund a large, roughly Rs 3,000 crore capacity expansion at the same time margins are under pressure, which raises the execution and cyclical-timing risk. The one clear bright spot is that promoters have been increasing their own stake through this downturn, suggesting insiders see it as temporary - but that alone does not offset the concrete profit and margin deterioration already on the books. We maintain the Sell call.
